description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans clusters using multiple grain directories with Redis as the storage backend. It defines a test class 'RedisMultipleGrainDirectoriesTests' that configures a test cluster with Redis grain directory support and includes a nested 'SiloConfigurator' class for silo configuration.

classes.name: RedisMultipleGrainDirectoriesTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying multiple grain directory configurations with Redis in Orleans clusters.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: A nested class implementing ISiloConfigurator to set up Redis grain directory options and logging for each silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to add Redis grain directory with specific options and logging filter.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if Redis is available before running tests.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster builder and adds the silo configurator.
